_comment: The authored layer for NPC placements. Nothing regenerates this file: it is the only one
a person edits by hand, and it wins over datos/npcs_reales.json, which a tool rewrites.
One row per placement: map, npc AND cell. The cell identifies it because the same NPC can
stand several times on one map - 18 of them do. Moving one is a remove plus a new row.
{ "map": 241438721, "npc": 1088, "cell": 260, "orientation": 3 }   place or re-face
{ "map": 241438721, "npc": 1088, "cell": 260 }                     place, keep facing
{ "map": 241438721, "npc": 1088, "cell": 260, "remove": true }    take that one out
The last one is the reason this file exists at all: an NPC Ankama places and we do not want
has to be removable without editing the generated file it came from, because that file is
rewritten by tools/extraer_npcs_reales.py and the edit would vanish.
The bankers of the banks no capture shows. Only Bonta's banker is measured (the jss of frame 16
of 'Interactivos varios/entrar en banco bonta...': template 6394 on cell 289 of 217059328,
facing 3). The other banks are placed here, INFERRED, on the same rule: the walkable cell of
the bank's first room nearest to Bonta's 289 -- the centre of the room, where he stands --
that no interactive and no other NPC takes, facing 3. The banker of each is the client's own:
the Brakmarian (6374) says 'the only safe place in Brakmar'; Moneo (3516) owes his bank to the
Parafrascos corporation of the cacterro desert, Picanesburgo's area; Yendong (5653) is taken
for Pandala by his name; the rest get the generic owl 'Banquero' (100). Astrub has two of its
own, Orroha Neuw (520) and Al Etsop (522), so it gets no owl; the one the derived layer had there
(100 on 318, 'placed by hand in Giny') is removed. The two stand behind their counter, which the
room's own floor shows: the counter is the unwalkable diagonal 258-272-287-301-316-330-345, with
the walkable lane between it and the vault. They take the lane's front row, 273 and 317, facing 3,
the counter, as Bonta's banker does; the derived layer had them on the room's emblem (356, 371).
Bonta's 289 is a cell nobody walks on -- he stands behind his counter -- but where each other bank's
counter is cannot be read off the data (captured NPCs stand on walkable, fight-only and unwalkable
cells alike: 151, 113 and 158), so these stand inside the room, where they can be reached.
Draconiros was briefly written here before it turned out datos/npcs_reales.json already
carried him - map 238553348, cell 206, orientation 3. He was invisible because his room had
no way in, not because he was unplaced, and restating a measurement in the authored layer
would have hidden that.
The Dream Market's two vendors, on its map 238683394 ('Dream Market', left of the well's):
Neru Stalar (7839) on cell 258, in front of the market's stall, and Gobribe (8000) beside him
on 276, both facing 1. INFERRED: no capture goes there; the guide says they are there.
Pepito (7030), at the Temple of Alliances (115083777): the client's help sends you to him there
(Translations 1149314, '{{map,13,35,1::Pepito}}', the map Hal Ylanza stands on) to trade nuggets
for pacifying crystals. INFERRED: no capture shows him; cell 329, walkable and free, two rows in
front of Hal Ylanza's 301, facing 1 as he does.
Cano Dhain (2345), who hands out the treasure hunts' quests on map 128452097 (the quests' own
givers say so), on cell 305 facing 3: beside the Anutrof box (element 484993, cell 290) his
lines send one to, at the right-hand corner of the room's counter. No capture shows the room.

Chantal Inea, who has one swear loyalty to Bonta or Brakmar before going down to the World of the Twelve (AlignmentHandler). INFERRED: no capture shows her; the client's map hint «Milicia» of Incarnam stands on 153878788 [0,-4], and of that square's indoor maps this one is the militia's office -- its counter, the cities' shields --; she stands behind the counter, facing the room.

Morry Gann, who makes one neutral again for a fee (AlignmentHandler). The Guardia de Amakna (2849) sends one to him: «¿Has jurado lealtad a Bonta o Brakmar y has cambiado de idea? Ve a ver a Morry Gann.», and the guides put him in Amakna's militia, behind the castle's door at [5,-6] (hint «Milicia», 68551681) -- the hall 95685125 the door leads into. INFERRED: the cell, by the hall's desk.
